en: Dependent on a state that is not of the sense-sphere, a state that is not of the sense-sphere arises by way of root-condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is not of the sense-sphere, a state that is not of the sense-sphere arises by way of root-condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is both not of the sense-sphere and not of the sense-sphere, a state that is not of the sense-sphere arises by way of root-condition … three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of the root condition, there are nine; in the object condition, four; in the predominance condition, five ... pe ... in the mutuality condition, six ... pe ... in the prenascence and repetition conditions, two ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition, nine.
